main_text.p: nisi ob incurrentes inextricabiles difficultates, quales hic nullæ apparent. Non tanquam ad inferiorem, quia ad inferiorem non fit remissio, nisi ad molestias superiore indignas evitandum, quales etiam hoc loco minime apparent. Præterea revera populum Christianum Synodus ludos fecit. Etenim postulatum calicis primitus ad Papam delatum, ille ad Synodum rejecit. Synodus petitionem justam, sex integros prius menses agitatam, dein ad accuratiorem disquisitionem duos iterum menses dilatam, postliminio ad Pontificem remisit. cum sine tanti temporis jactura, absque tot officiis ac laboribus in ipso statim principio ad ipsum remitti potuerit. Unde publica querela sonabat, conditionem Christianorum esse juxta prophetiam Esaiæ: Manda, remanda. Expecta, reexpecta. Denique alii non erubuerunt levato velo dicere quod res est, nimirum Synodum hoc decreto haud obscure fallam esse, rationes eas, quibus calix à nonnullis negatus est, idoneas & sufficientes haud esse. Nam si dioneas judicâssent, in prohibitione perseverandum fuisse. Si dubias, in examine perpendum.

page.notes: Woodcut ornament (winged cherub with cross-like finials) between the text and the catchword is not transcribed. The word "perpendum" is printed as "gendum" at the line start; reading "gendum" as printed in the scan, with the line "fuisse. Si dubias, in examine per" above it. The passage has a few doubtful readings: "dioneas" and "judicâssent" (printed "judicâffent") and "gendum" are as printed.
